Hi Maria / Rishi — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise, procurement-friendly summary you can attach to the RFP. This reflects Redwood's standard hosted and enterprise (Dedicated/Private) behaviors as of Oct 2026; contractual language can be added to a Master Services Agreement.

1) Do you persist full prompts and model outputs?
- Hosted (default): By default, Redwood stores full request content (prompts and model outputs) for up to 30 calendar days. Storage is used for billing reconciliation, abuse detection, debugging, and quality/regression monitoring. Access to stored content is restricted to authorized SRE/security personnel and all access is logged.
- Dedicated: For Dedicated environments (reserved customer clusters), persistent storage of prompt/output content is configurable. Customers can opt into zero-content-retention; when configured, full prompts/outputs are not written to persistent storage. Ephemeral inference caches (KV cache) are used during inference but are not persisted to durable storage.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): All data remains in the customer-managed VPC/on-prem environment; Redwood's control plane does not retain prompt/output content unless explicitly configured.

2) Can we disable storage of prompt/output content entirely?
- Yes. Options: (a) For hosted customers, enable the DO_NOT_STORE flag for your account; when enabled, Redwood will not persist full prompt/output content to durable storage. Metadata required for billing (token counts, timestamps) will still be retained. (b) Alternatively, move to Dedicated or Private where storage can be configured to meet your retention policy (including zero retention).

3) Where is data stored by default and residency guarantees?
- Hosted default: data is stored in the region backing your account (US by default). We can guarantee US-only storage (e.g., us-east-1 or us-west-2) in the contract and will deploy storage & backups in-region. We also offer EU residency (eu-west-1) and APAC options upon request.

4) Encryption and key management (BYOK):
- All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256).
- BYOK is available for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted customers, we support KMS with customer-managed keys for enterprise plans; HSM-backed keys are available for higher tiers and per-contract.

5) Deletion SLA and certificates:
- Upon contractually agreed deletion request, Redwood will delete prompt/output content from primary and backup stores within 30 calendar days and provide a deletion certificate. For Dedicated/Private, deletion procedures are performed in-customer-environment per the agreed SOW (can be instant if configured).

Additional notes:
- Billing and audit metadata (token counts, timestamps, usage metrics) are retained for up to 365 days for invoicing and support purposes; summary metrics may be retained longer in aggregated/anonymized form.
- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II controls; see attached SOC2 summary for details.
- Contractual language: We are happy to add explicit residency, retention, and deletion clauses in the MSA and to produce a one-page attestation for procurement.

Next steps: Nikhil, please offer a 30-minute technical call to validate integration patterns (API flags, sample payloads) and to confirm how DO_NOT_STORE will look in the integration. Maria — if this looks good I’ll draft the one-page RFP attestation and the proposed SOW language.

— Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Maria — thanks for the patience. Per Neha's note above (copied), here are the procurement-ready bullets you can include in your RFP:

- Hosted default: prompts and outputs are retained up to 30 days (full content) for billing, debugging, and abuse monitoring.
- DO_NOT_STORE option: hosted customers can enable DO_NOT_STORE to prevent persistent storage of prompt/output content; billing metadata retained.
- Dedicated/Private: persistent storage can be disabled entirely; Private keeps all data in-customer VPC.
- Residency: we can contractually guarantee US-only storage (we will provision account-backed storage in us-east-1).
- Encryption/BYOK: AES-256 at rest, TLS in transit; BYOK/HSM options available for enterprise contracts.
- Deletion SLA: deletion and certificate within 30 days for hosted; immediate/contracted processes for Dedicated/Private.
